entries.title: Build requests retired index target
entries.root_cause: The workflow requests //indexer:release_bundle, a target no longer defined in the indexer package after its rename to release_archive. The workflow must use the new target name.

entries.title: Build requests absent schema target
entries.root_cause: The workflow requests //schema:descriptor_set, but the schema BUILD file defines descriptors instead. Correct the schema target label in the workflow.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Another Bazel target lookup fails with similar wording, but the invalid label is in a different package and requires a separate workflow correction.

entries.title: Sandbox cannot write generated index
entries.root_cause: The catalog compiler writes its generated index into the read-only source tree inside the Bazel sandbox. The rule must direct the compiler output to its declared output path.

entries.title: Sandbox rejects source tree output again
entries.root_cause: The catalog compiler writes its generated index into the read-only source tree inside the Bazel sandbox. The rule must direct the compiler output to its declared output path.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later build on another runner uses a different sandbox and output path, with different progress and timing, but the compiler still attempts the same source-tree write.
